description: This PHP source file defines a class 'SessionSubscriber' in the OrangeHRM project, which subscribes to the Symfony 'KernelEvents::REQUEST' event to manage user sessions, specifically invalidating sessions after a timeout period.

classes.name: SessionSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber to Symfony kernel request events that manages session timeout by invalidating the session if it remains idle beyond the configured maximum session idle time.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events and corresponding callback methods that this subscriber listens to. Specifically subscribes to the Kernel request event with a high priority.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event, retrieves the current session from the service container, checks if the session has been idle longer than the maximum allowed idle time, and invalidates it if necessary.
